_doc: Operator-authored Google My Maps layers, one per shuttle line, linked by QR codes on the official 2025-2026 Shuttle Bus Map PDF. KML exports are saved to data/bus/raw/<season>/mymaps/<mid>.kml via https://www.google.com/maps/d/kml?mid=<mid>&forcekml=1 and read by `python -m hakuba_api.bus.import_mymaps`.
